import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for survival
survival_palette = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
survival_labels = {0: 'Did not survive', 1: 'Survived'}

# Plot 1: Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
for survived in [0, 1]:
    subset = df_age[df_age['survived'] == survived]
    ax2.hist(subset['age'], bins=20, alpha=0.6, label=survival_labels[survived], 
             color=survival_palette[survived], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# Plot 3: Survival count by embark town
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=[survival_palette[0], survival_palette[1]], 
                     edgecolor='black', stacked=True)
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Town', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Survival by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(title='Survival', labels=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Fare vs Age colored by survival with class distinction
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['age', 'fare'])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df_clean['age'], df_clean['fare'], 
                      c=df_clean['survived'].map(survival_palette),
                      alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5,
                      s=df_clean['pclass'].map({1: 100, 2: 60, 3: 30}))
ax4.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age (size = class, color = survival)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)

# Create custom legend for survival
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=survival_palette[1], label='Survived', alpha=0.6),
                   Patch(facecolor=survival_palette[0], label='Did not survive', alpha=0.6),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                          markersize=12, label='1st Class'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                          markersize=9, label='2nd Class'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='gray', 
                          markersize=6, label='3rd Class')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
